exposure: placental FPN mass to TfR1 mass ratio (PIDI index)
cohort: The study included 42 pregnant women who provided serum and placenta samples, divided into four groups based on gestational week.
finding: Women with preterm birth exhibited significantly reduced maternal serum iron, diminished maternal hepcidin, and reduced placental iron stores with an increased placental FPN mass to TfR1 mass ratio compared to women with full-term birth.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected from pregnant women around the time of birth, categorized as preterm or full-term based on gestational week.
gest_age: Women categorized by gestational week as preterm or full-term.
